items.title: Pipeline inflation: producer prices vs consumer prices (YoY)
items.description: Producer prices (PPI final demand) vs consumer prices (CPI), year-over-year, since 2011. PPI has re-accelerated above CPI in 2026.
items.reason: October PPI is out at 8:30 AM ET today; this shows whether pipeline inflation is still running ahead of consumer prices.

items.title: 17 Treasury stocks 2026 YTD
